topic: Sea cucumbers shoot out their insides
script: When a sea cucumber is attacked, it can shoot out some of its own insides. The sticky organs can tangle up or distract a predator. Then the sea cucumber grows them back. Many sea cucumbers breathe by pumping water in and out of their rear end. A small fish called the pearlfish sometimes lives inside them. They help clean the sea floor by swallowing sand and digesting the bits of food in it. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
